column1: # What each mod's own gear does at default config on 1.21.1, read from dedicated servers or the mod's source.
# damage and speed: its sword, as the tooltip shows them. durability: 9001 stands in for unbreakable gear.
# mining: its pickaxe. Armor columns: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots. 0 means the mod has no such number.
